To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the magnetic field produces anomalies in the power spectrum that are both sudden decreases and sudden increases of the mode frequencies.
1) The magnetic perturbations to mode frequencies are sensitive to the magnetic field configuration and to the mode degree.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the magnetic perturbations to axisymmetric, low-degree, high-radial order, pulsations of roAp stars permeated by a large-scale magnetic field.
the following topics: (1) The magnetic perturbations to pulsations in magnetic stars are studied.
the study of the magnetic perturbations to low-degree, high-radial-order, axisymmetric pulsation frequencies of stellar models permeated with large-scale magnetic fields of different geometries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the magnetic anomalies depend on the geometry of both the magnetic field and the modes.

the magnetic field produces a strong anomaly in the power spectrum of roAp stars only for a particular magnetic field configuration, namely, for a quadrupolar magnetic field aligned along the rotation axis.

magnetic fields with a superposition of an aligned dipolar and a quadrupolar component produce a larger variety of frequency anomalies than those produced by a pure magnetic dipole or a pure magnetic quadrupole.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the anomalies in the power spectrum of roAp stars may be used as an indicator of the geometry of the magnetic field.
the magnetic field can produce anomalies in the power spectrum of pulsations in the form of frequency gaps and/or frequency peaks.
magnetic perturbations of pulsation modes are a powerful tool to learn about magnetic fields.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the magnetic field is a powerful tool for probing stellar interiors.
the anomalies are not a consequence of the magnetic field, but a consequence of the geometry of the magnetic field.
the frequency shifts and the magnetic anomalies depend on the degree of pulsations.
